vibe_rationale: Australia's first national community sauna gathering, run by a new not-for-profit with a community-first culture; a small single format.
fit_notes: Near-perfect category fit: heat, cold plunge, breathwork and recovery, with wellness brands already among its major partners. The organiser is new and still building its partner base, so a founding-partner role for 2027 is a realistic, low-cost first step. The audience is all ages (clothed sessions), and attendance is not published.
